gates.description: Approve Additional Use Grant, group/revenue definition, commercial agreement and per-version Change Date mechanism.
Confirm rights to license every owned contribution and marketing asset, excluding all upstream materials.

MIT is explicitly declared in the pinned README and accepted as build evidence. The empty linked LICENSE produces a warning, not an automatic build veto. The complete copyright/license notice remains an open follow-up; no attribution or legal approval is invented.
Review final per-platform container and companion SBOMs, Cargo/Go/Python dependencies, CUDA/driver EULAs, source offers and upstream commercial exclusions.
Approve the synchronized PDF/PPTX/raster materials and their provenance before publication.
Verify the final images on an appliance, including local login/recovery, Federated SSO expiry and Mesh/Sharing without a license.
